d: Kokroch janta parti (sijepi) ke 6 jun ko shuru hue virodh pradarshan ke bad se ab tak desh men kaee bar alag-alag muddon ko lekar log sarkon par utre hain. pahle mang thi shiksha mantri ke pad se dharmendr pradhan ka istifa. ye pradarshan nit pepar lik ko lekar hue the. iske bad jantar mantar aur phir ramlila maidan men log esaaaeeaar ke khilaf ekjut hue aur mukhy chunav aayukt ke pad se gyanesh kumar ke istife ki mang huee. in sabhi pradarshanon men jo alag dekhne ko mila, vo tha kviyar samuday ke logon ki inmen hissedari. in sabhi ke pradarshan karne ke tarike bhi kaphi alag rahe. kviyar…
